messages:
sara: Quick plan: bringing a new quant target (q4b-lite) into a dry-run. need to carve a smaller curation set that keeps long-context and rare intents.
linh: current promptbank ~1.3M. propose stratified sparsify by (intent, len_bin, source_anchor) then sem-sim dedupe inside buckets. cap per-bucket.
owen: OK. what final size are we aiming for?
sara: prefer 50k-100k final; also reserve a 2k frozen golden set for regressions.
ben: labeling for golden: fast-pass labelers mark OK/FAIL, then expert adjudication for conflicts. estimate ~2.5 FTE-weeks.
linh: sample CLI (will push to repo):
```
python tools/sparsify_bank.py \
  --input s3://redwood/promptbank/v1.3/ \
  --group intent,len_bin,anchor_id \
  --sparsity 0.1 \
  --sim_thresh 0.9 \
  --cap 120 \
  --summary-csv s3://redwood/curation/q4b-lite/summary.csv \
  --out s3://redwood/curation/q4b-lite/sparsified/
```
linh: normalization: lowercase, unicode-normalize, strip-urls, normalize-quotes; use lm-tokenizer-v2 for embedding sim. include sample_dropped in summary.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-2309 created: "q4b-lite sparsify + golden holdout" assigned @linh @ben. https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INF-2309
sara: timeline: Tue run sparsify, Tue PM review, Wed-Thu label golden, Fri run quant dry-run. everyone ack?
owen: ack. I'll reserve canary infra and add 25% buffer.
linh: ack. will run a small smoke sample now and post summary link in INF-2309.
ben: ack. provisioning labeling queue and tagging tasks `q4b-golden`.
sara: thanks — flag anything weird in the ticket (cohort collapse, missing rare intents). :thumbsup:
